known_duplicate.title: Memory is Reconstructed, Not Retrieved: Graph Memory for LLM Agents

links.scope_note_en: Transformer bounded-diameter graph connectivity and MPNN graph algorithm approximation differ in task, architecture and sample guarantees.
Disentangled Transformer with capacity-bound training distribution is not the bounded-degree finite-precision LOCAL MLP/GNN model.
Connectivity algorithm training cannot replace GRAIL deterministic directed graph reachability labeling oracle.
Graph label selection uses observed supervised vertex-label budget k, not reachability index labels and query correctness.
Freeze graph family and exact prediction task; separate k selected labels from transformer learned algorithm capacity.
LAMP dynamic snapshot stability and resolution-based GNN noncontinuity use different dynamics and topology limits.
Dynamic learned state dissipation does not pay the measured storage costs of query, ingest and update for agent graph databases.
Compare temporal graph representation retention with persistent-history graph memory under exact timestamp and tombstone oracles.
VimRAG reasoning/evidence DAG with adaptive visual token retention differs from wGraph workflow orchestration with KV cache sharing.
Compare multimodal DAG-guided evidence access to associative graph reconstruction on compatible evidence recall tasks.
Compare graph-guided multimodal retrieval to strong vector/lexical RAG under equal context tokens and evidence coverage.
DualGraph separates outline and knowledge structures; VimRAG maintains a joint reasoning evidence DAG.
Include sparse and flat retrieval baselines before attributing gains to knowledge-graph topology.
Use source-identity nodes and evidence-claim provenance edges to guide Mathlab agent gap search; any edge requires independent source verification.
DualGraph outline/knowledge planning and MRAgent associative cue-tag-content retrieval solve distinct tasks and are not duplicate research.

model_bridges.boundary: Graph connectivity learning, k vertex labels for classification, and RAG reasoning traces cannot be substituted for exact adaptive immutable directed reachability or priced metadata updates.
Approximate supervised graph label selection and Transformer learned graph connectivity have different objective functions, oracles, capacity and training distributions.
Neural state dissipation, graph retrieval path pruning and outline gap planning cannot establish authenticated history preservation, temporal freshness or logical truth.
Observed vertex target label budget, learned representation stability and compressed visual tokens have no direct bound on WAL/fsync, SSD bytes rewritten or page recourse.
Design analogy only: bibliographic evidence graph and research question map must use pinned sources and typed reviewed edges rather than fabricated citations.
